title: Ensure onboarding checklist deep links are version-stable (docs URL canonicalization + redirects)
creator: Dylan Brooks
description:
Background
- The new Console guided onboarding checklist includes deep links to docs for each step (first request, streaming, tool calling/structured output basics, error handling/retries, quotas/429, first production launch).
- Docs IA is in flux (new landing pages + navigation changes), and we’ve already seen links drift during review.

Problem
- Checklist links must not break when docs are reorganized (or when docs are published with versioned paths).
- We also need consistent attribution on docs links (UTM convention) so PM/Analytics can measure step click-through and correlate it with funnel completion.

Goal
- Make every checklist docs link point to a stable canonical URL.
- Add redirects for any legacy/temporary URLs used during beta so existing Console deployments and external bookmarks continue to work.

Non-goals
- Rewriting docs content or owning overall docs IA decisions (owned by Docs/DevEx).
- Adding step validation logic (separate tickets).

Proposed approach
1) Define canonical (version-stable) doc URLs per checklist step
   - Use unversioned, stable paths (e.g., /docs/hosted-api/quickstart/first-request) that docs infra guarantees as the long-lived entry point.
   - If docs site uses versioned builds internally, it should maintain stable aliases and/or redirects from versioned paths to canonical paths.

2) Centralize checklist link targets in one mapping
   - Create a single mapping file used by the Console checklist config so link updates don’t require editing multiple components.
   - Ensure link-building appends UTM parameters per DES-115.

3) Add redirects in docs site for any changed paths
   - Implement redirects for: old quickstart paths, temporary beta paths, and any renamed pages from the IA update.
   - Redirects must preserve query params (so UTMs aren’t lost).

Acceptance criteria
- All checklist steps link to canonical URLs (no version strings, no temporary slugs).
- Redirect rules exist for known old paths referenced in early builds/beta.
- Redirect behavior preserves query parameters and anchors.
- Links include agreed UTM parameters (utm_source=console, utm_medium=in_product, utm_campaign=guided_onboarding, utm_content=<step_id>).
- Smoke test: clicking each step link from Console (beta flag on) results in HTTP 200 and lands on the intended section.

Implementation notes
- Console side:
  - Add a small utility to build docs URLs from a base + path + utm params.
  - Add a step_id per checklist item and use it for utm_content.
  - Avoid hardcoding full URLs in JSX; keep them in the checklist step definition.
- Docs side:
  - Coordinate with Elliot/Wei on canonical paths and redirect ownership.
  - Prefer server-side redirects (or Next.js redirects config) so redirects apply uniformly.

Testing plan
- Unit test: URL builder appends UTMs, preserves existing query params, and URL-encodes step IDs.
- E2E smoke: in checklist, validate that each docs link has expected base domain + utm params.
- Manual: verify redirects for the known legacy list (see comments).

Rollout
- Safe to ship under the checklist feature flag.
- If any canonical doc URL changes post-beta, update mapping + add redirect on docs site before widening cohort.

Open questions
- Final canonical paths are pending Docs IA signoff (Confluence: onboarding-info-architecture-update-2026).
- Confirm whether docs site guarantees stable aliases per page or only per section (Elliot to confirm).
comments: 2026-02-04 (Elliot Price): Please avoid linking to /docs/<version>/… paths. We can guarantee stable /docs/hosted-api/... paths and will maintain redirects when we cut new versions. Also +1 on preserving query params for UTMs.

2026-02-05 (Kenji Nakamura): For the checklist UI, we’ll show links as “Read docs” and “View example”. Please ensure the UTM content value matches the internal step_id so analytics can map clicks to steps cleanly (see DES-115).

2026-02-07 (Hannah Rivera): Implemented central mapping in Console checklist config. Added docsLink(stepId, path) utility that appends UTMs (source=console, medium=in_product, campaign=guided_onboarding, content=stepId). Will follow up with a short PR to add a Jest test for query/anchor handling.

2026-02-10 (Wei Chen): Canonical URLs confirmed for Phase 1 steps. Please redirect these legacy paths used in early drafts: /docs/getting-started/first-request -> /docs/hosted-api/quickstart/first-request; /docs/getting-started/streaming -> /docs/hosted-api/streaming; /docs/production/launch-checklist -> /docs/hosted-api/production/first-production-launch.

2026-02-12 (Marissa Cole): Beta cohort starts next week; broken deep links are a support burden. Can we add a lightweight console-side link health check in QA (even just a checklist in the QA plan) to avoid regressions?

2026-02-18 (Hannah Rivera): Redirects added on docs site and verified locally to preserve query params. Console links updated to canonical paths. Posted legacy redirect list in docs PR for future maintenance.
2026-02-22 (Dylan Brooks): Marking done. Please keep an eye on any 404s in telemetry during beta (if we see spikes, we’ll extend redirect coverage).
